statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail 23 reflects unresolved Gulf escalation, Hormuz disruption and Friday's rates repricing while NQ is closed and live persistent price-path evidence is unavailable.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold during the closure; the Sunday futures reopening is the next live checkpoint for gap persistence, retracement quality and cross-asset confirmation.
headline: Weekend Gulf risk remains at WATCH as Sunday Nasdaq futures reopening approaches
body: NQ is closed. No newly verified escalation since the prior assessment materially changes the setup. U.S.-Iran vessel conflict, constrained Gulf shipping and Friday's stronger payroll-driven yield rise keep Stress extreme, while the absence of live continuation or failed-retracement evidence keeps Tail at 23.

lookbackSummary: Published lookback: Tail was low at 18 from 02:00 through 08:00 UTC Saturday, then moved to WATCH at 24 from 09:00 UTC through 01:00 UTC Sunday after verified vessel escalation raised reopening-gap risk.
outlookSummary: Under stable headlines Tail can ease during the closed period, then risk concentrates at the Sunday Globex reopening. Elevated Tail from 22:00 UTC is conditional on a directional gap with shallow or failed retracements and cross-asset pressure; orderly two-sided discovery would invalidate that path. Monday cash trading is closed for Labor Day.
